notes.title: Playtest Now Live!
notes.content:
[p]Thank you so much for your patience while we sorted through playtest requests — we really appreciate your support! 🙏[/p][p][/p][p]We’re thrilled to announce that the playtest is now open! 🎉[/p][p]🔥 Jump in now and [b]climb the leaderboard[/b] — can you secure a top spot?[/p][p]
👥 [b]Invite your friends[/b] and see who can grab the highest score![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45601450/e27f1d84e0a83bd02b9422b4183c2cd71331dd54.png"][/img][/p][p]💡 [b]Love what you see?[/b][/p][p]Be sure to [b]follow us on [/b][url="https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/1772846759/metal-genesis"]Kickstarter[/url] to support the game's future and stay updated on our campaign!

Your feedback means the world to us, so dive in, have fun, and let us know what you think![/p][p]See you in the game! 💪[/p]
